blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adversarial patches are a practical threat to traffic-sign recognition: a small sticker on a sign can change a classifier's decision. PatchCleanser is a certified defense that applies two rounds of masking and, for every image it certifies, provably returns the correct label for any patch that fits inside one mask. We show that on traffic signs the defense certifies almost nothing when paired with a normally trained classifier (1.7% to 4.8% certified accuracy on GTSRB), because a single mask can hide the small central symbol that distinguishes sign classes. We propose mask-aware training, which trains the classifier on images occluded by random pairs drawn from the defense's own mask set, with a sampling bias toward masks over the sign's centre. The defense, mask set and certification procedure are unchanged, so the guarantee is preserved. For an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, mask-aware training raises certified accuracy from 4.8% to 60.0%. Under real per-image adversarial patches, the defended ResNet-50 reaches 85.7% accuracy, versus 74.6% for the original PatchCleanser with a normally trained ResNet-50.
blocks.zh: 逆向补丁是对交通标志识别的实际威胁:在标志上贴上小贴可以改变分类者的决定. PatchCleanser是一种经过认证的防御,它应用两轮遮罩,并且,对于它所验证的每个图像,可以证明返回任何符合一个遮罩内的补丁的正确标签. 我们显示,在交通标志上,如果配对一个通常经过训练的分类器(GTSRB上为1.7%至4.8%的认证精度),则辩护方几乎不会认证任何内容,因为一个单一的面具可以隐藏区别标志类的小中央符号. 我们提议进行口罩意识训练, 训练分类员使用从防守者自己的口罩组中抽取的随机对联的图像, 对口罩进行取样偏重于标志中心。 辩护,面具套装和认证程序不变,因此保修保留. 对于一个ImageNet-pressed ResNet-50,口罩意识训练将认证的精度从4.8%提高到60.0%. 在真实的逐象对抗补丁下,防守的ResNet-50达到85.7%的准确度,而原装有通常训练有素的ResNet-50的PatchCleanser则达到74.6%.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Deep classifiers used in driver assistance and autonomous driving read traffic signs from camera
images. Physical adversarial patches, small printed stickers placed on or near an object, can cause
confident misclassification [ 2 , 3 ] . Empirical defenses are routinely
broken by adaptive attacks, which motivates certified defenses: methods that prove a
prediction cannot be changed by any patch of a given size [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh:
司机协助和自动驾驶中使用的深层分类器读取相机上的交通标志
图像。 贴在物体上或附近的小型印刷贴纸,可造成
自信错分类[2,3]. 经验辩护是例行公事
由适应性攻击所打破,这种攻击激励了经过认证的防御:
预言不能被任何给定大小的补丁所改变 [4, 5, 6].

blocks.en:
PatchCleanser [ 1 ] is a certified defense that works with any image
classifier. It evaluates the classifier on images occluded by one and then two masks from an R-covering mask set and certifies an image when all two-mask predictions agree with the label.
blocks.zh:
PatchCleaner [1] 是一个认证的用于任何图像的防御
分类者. 它在被一个和两个口罩从一个R-覆盖口罩套装上吞噬的图像上评价分级器,并在所有两个口罩的预测都与标签一致时验证一个图像.

blocks.en:
Traffic signs are harder. A sign’s class is decided by a small symbol at its centre (the digits of
a speed limit, the pictogram of a warning sign), and a mask sized to cover a patch can hide that symbol
entirely. We find that PatchCleanser with a normally trained model certifies only 1.7% to 4.8% of
GTSRB test images. This paper makes the following contributions: • An end-to-end certified-patch-defense pipeline for traffic signs (GTSRB), including training,
per-image adversarial patch generation, two-mask inference and certification. • Mask-aware training : training with random pairs from the defense’s own mask set, biased
toward the grid centre. It requires no change to inference and keeps the certificate valid. • A comparison with the original PatchCleanser on a wide CNN and a ResNet-50: certified accuracy
rises from 1.7–4.8% to 53.5–60.0%, and accuracy under real adversarial patches from 72.8–74.6%
to 80.9–85.7%.

blocks.en: II Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: II- 1 Adversarial patches
blocks.zh: II-1 横向补丁

blocks.en:
Brown et al. [ 2 ] introduced universal, printable adversarial patches, and Eykholt
et al. [ 3 ] demonstrated physical sticker attacks that cause stop signs to be misread.
The attacker controls all pixels inside a contiguous region and nothing outside it.
blocks.zh:
布朗等编. [2] 推出通用可打印的对抗补丁,和 Eykholt
等 [3] 演示出物理粘贴攻击,导致停止信号被误读.
攻击者控制着一个相接区域内部的所有像素以及它以外的任何东西.

blocks.en: II- 2 Certified patch defenses
blocks.zh: 二. 2个认证补丁防御

blocks.en:
Interval bound propagation [ 4 ] , derandomized smoothing [ 5 ] and small-receptive-field models [ 6 ] give provable guarantees but constrain the
architecture. PatchCleanser [ 1 ] is architecture-agnostic, and later work
improves its efficiency and utility [ 7 , 8 ] . Saha et al. [ 9 ] show that occlusion-based training (Greedy Cutout) improves PatchCleanser on natural-image benchmarks;
PatchCleanser itself fine-tunes with Cutout [ 10 ] . We study the traffic-sign
domain, where the defense fails without such training, and train with the defense’s own mask pairs.
blocks.zh:
相互约束的传播[4],去随机平滑[5]和小受地模型[6]提供了可证明的保证,但限制了
结构。 PatchCleanser [1] 是架构不可知的, 后期的工作
提高其效率和效用[7、8]。 萨哈等. [9] 显示基于隔离的培训(Greedy Cutout)改进了自然图像基准上的补丁清除器;
PatchCleanser本身的微调与Cutout [10]. 我们研究交通标志
,在没有这种训练的情况下,防御失败,并使用防御自己的口罩对进行训练。

R-covering for the patch. A two-mask prediction uses an unordered pair { i , j } \{i,j\} of masks, with i = j i=j meaning a single mask, so there are ( 36 2 ) + 36 = 630 + 36 = 666 \binom{36}{2}+36=630+36=666 of them, i.e. k ⁡ ( k + 1 ) / 2 k(k+1)/2 .

inference needs at most 666, since Algorithm 2 evaluates two-mask predictions only for

blocks.en: V-B Robustness to Real Adversarial Patches
blocks.zh: V-B 稳健到真实的异常补丁

blocks.en:
Without a defense, adversarial patches reduce accuracy to 70.0–80.7% (Table II ). The
original PatchCleanser makes this slightly worse (72.8% vs. 76.1% and 74.6% vs. 76.6%), because
the normally trained model misclassifies the masked images. With ours the defended accuracy reaches
80.9% and 85.7%, 8.1 and 11.1 points above the original. Fig. 1 shows examples.

通常经过训练的模型对被蒙住的图像进行错误分类。 我们的防御精度达到了
80.9%和85.7%,8.1和11.1分比原高. 图1显示了实例。

blocks.en: V-C Limitations
blocks.zh: V-C 限制

blocks.en:
We use 2,000 of the 12,630 test images (666 forward passes per image). The adversarial patch
targets the undefended model, not the defense; certified accuracy holds against any patch. Each
setting is trained once, and all patches are digital.
blocks.zh:
我们使用12 630个测试图像中的2 000个(每个图像前传666个)。 对抗补丁
目标为未设防的模型,而非防御;经认证的准确性与任何补丁相抵. 每个
设置被培训过一次,所有的补丁都是数字的。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
PatchCleanser’s guarantee transfers to traffic-sign recognition only if the classifier can recognize
signs with a mask over their central symbol. Mask-aware training with the defense’s own mask pairs and
a centre bias supplies this ability without modifying the defense. On GTSRB our best model, a
ResNet-50, goes from 4.8% to 60.0% certified and reaches 85.7% defended accuracy under adversarial
patches. Future work
includes the full test set and physical stickers.

blocks.en: Appendix A — Terminology and Definitions
blocks.zh: 附录A——术语和定义

blocks.en: GTSRB : The German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark [ 11 ] contains 39,270 natural images of 43 road sign classes (26,640 train, 12,630 test) across diverse scales, lighting, and degradation. We evaluate on a fixed subset of 2,000 test images with identical patch coordinates across all models.
blocks.zh: GTSRB:德国交通标志识别基准 [11] 包含43个路标等级的39,270个自然图像(26,640个列车,12,630个测试),跨越了不同的尺度,照明和退化. 我们评估一个固定的子集 2,000个测试图像 有相同的补丁坐标 在所有模型。

blocks.en: Adversarial patch : A localized perturbation [ 2 , 3 ] where an adversary freely modifies pixels within a bounded spatial region (e.g., a physical sticker on a sign), leaving other pixels intact. In our threat model, the patch covers 2.4% of pixels ( 5 × 5 5\times 5 on 32 × 32 32\times 32 , 20 × 20 20\times 20 on 128 × 128 128\times 128 ).
blocks.zh: 逆向补丁:局部扰动 [2, 3] 对手在被限制的空间区域内自由修改像素(如在标志上贴上物理贴子),使其他像素完好无损. 在我们的威胁模型中,补丁覆盖了像素的2.4%(5×5 5\时为32×32相32相32相32相32相20相20相20相128相128相128相).

blocks.en: Threat model : Formal adversary definition: placing one square patch of up to 2.4% pixel area anywhere on the sign with arbitrary continuous RGB values to cause misclassification, subject to no L p L_{p} -norm bound.
blocks.zh: 威胁模式 : 正式的对手定义 : 在标志上放置一平方块, 以任意连续的 RGB 值在任何地方最多 2.4% 像素区域来引起错误的分类, 但不受 L p- =- Norm 绑定 。

blocks.en: Defense : An algorithmic pipeline wrapped around a classifier to resist attacks. Here, we evaluate PatchCleanser, a certified defense based on two rounds of spatial masking.
blocks.zh: 防御:一个被分类器包裹的算法管来抵御攻击. 在这里,我们评价了PatchCleanser,一种基于两轮空间遮罩的认证防御.

blocks.en: PatchCleanser : An architecture-agnostic certified defense [ 1 ] that guarantees robustness against localized patches via double masking without modifying model weights.
blocks.zh: 补丁清除器 : 一个建筑学-不可知性认证的防御[1],通过双面遮罩保证坚固性来抵御局部补丁而无需修改模型重量.

blocks.en: Mask : A spatial occlusion operator m ∈ { 0 , 1 } H × W m\in\{0,1\}^{H\times W} setting pixels to zero in a square window ( x ⊙ m x\odot m ) prior to inference ( 9 × 9 9\times 9 for 32 × 32 32\times 32 ; 38 × 38 38\times 38 for 128 × 128 128\times 128 ), suppressing adversarial patches.

Mask set, k k : A discrete set ℳ = { m 1 , … , m k } \mathcal{M}=\{m_{1},\dots,m_{k}\} of k = 36 k=36 masks arranged on a uniform 6 × 6 6\times 6 grid across the image, governing spatial resolution and evaluation overhead.
blocks.zh: 口罩设置, kk : 一个离散的集 M = { m 1,., m k }\ mathcal{ M }=\{ m_{ 1},\ dots, m_{k = 36 k = 36 口罩,排列在6×6 6\times 6个网格上横跨图像,管理空间分辨率和评价上层.

blocks.en: R-covering : The structural property ensuring every valid p × p p\times p patch location is fully enclosed by at least one mask. Sizing masks to p + s − 1 p+s-1 for stride s s guarantees covering across continuous offsets.
blocks.zh: R-覆盖 : 确保每个有效的p × p\times p补丁位置的结构属性被至少一个口罩完全封闭. 将口罩缩到p + s − 1 p +s-1,用于覆盖连续相抵的脚步式保证。

blocks.en: One-/two-mask prediction : Model inferences on occluded inputs: y ^ i = f ⁡ ( x ⊙ m i ) \hat{y}_{i}=f(x\odot m_{i}) for single mask m i m_{i} ; y ^ i ​ j = f ⁡ ( x ⊙ m i ⊙ m j ) \hat{y}_{ij}=f(x\odot m_{i}\odot m_{j}) for mask pair { m i , m j } \{m_{i},m_{j}\} ( i = j i=j denotes single mask).
blocks.zh: 单相/双相干预测: 对已插入输入的模型推论 :y ^ i = f → (x ⊙ m i )\hat{i}=f (x\odot m_{i}) 对于单面口罩 m i → m_{i};y ^ i j = f → (x ⊙ m ⊙ m j )\hat{i}_{ (x\odot m_{i}\ m_{j )对于口罩对 { m i, m jj } {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我还得说 (一=j i=j表示单口罩).

blocks.en: 666 (Two-mask evaluations) : Total count of unordered mask pairs from k = 36 k=36 masks, including pairing a mask with itself: ( 36 2 ) + 36 = 36 × 37 2 = 666 \binom{36}{2}+36=\frac{36\times 37}{2}=666 , evaluated once per sample and shared.
blocks.zh: 666 (双任务评价): K=36克=36个口罩的无序口罩对数总数,包括将口罩与自己配对:(36 2)+36 = 36 × 37 2 = 666\binom{36}{2}+36\frac{36\times 37}{2}=666,每个样本评价一次并共享.

blocks.en: Double masking : PatchCleanser’s inference rule (Algorithm 2 ). It checks consensus among one-mask predictions (Case I) and identifies if a minority prediction consistently disagrees across secondary masks (Case II); otherwise majority vote is returned (Case III).
blocks.zh: 双面罩 : PatchCleanser的推论规则(算法 2 ). 它检查一个任务预测(例一)之间的共识,并查明某一少数群体的预测是否在次要任务面具方面始终有分歧(例二);否则多数表决被退回(例三)。

blocks.en: Certificate : Formal verification that no patch in the threat model can change the defended output on a clean image (Algorithm 3 ), proven when all 666 two-mask evaluations match label y y .
blocks.zh: 证书 : 正式验证威胁模型中没有任何补丁可以改变一个干净图像上被保护的输出(Algorithm 3 ),当所有666个双任务评价都与标签 y 相匹配时就证明了.

blocks.en: Certified accuracy : Fraction of test images correctly classified and certified, establishing an attack-independent lower bound on defended accuracy against any admissible patch.
blocks.zh: 经认证的准确性: 测试图像的分数正确分类和认证,在防御的准确性上对任何可接受补丁建立了独立的攻击下限.

blocks.en: No defense / Defense : Comparative evaluation settings: No defense measures raw classifier accuracy; Defense measures accuracy when wrapped inside the double-masking pipeline.
blocks.zh: 无防御/ 防御: 比较评价设置 : 没有防御测量原始分级器精度; 防御测量精确度,当被包裹在双假面管内时.

blocks.en: Mask-aware training : Our training method (Algorithm 1 ) optimizing the classifier on images occluded by sampled pairs from ℳ \mathcal{M} , conditioning it to recognize signs under dual occlusions.
blocks.zh: 面具意识培训: 我们的训练方法(agorithm 1)优化了从M\mathcal{M}取出样本对映的图像的分级器,使其在双重封存下识别出标志.

blocks.en: Centre bias : A sampling distribution π \pi during training where mask i i is drawn from interior masks ℐ ⊂ ℳ \mathcal{I}\subset\mathcal{M} ( 4 × 4 4\times 4 ) with probability 0.5 (else uniformly), forcing reliance on peripheral cues.
blocks.zh: 中心偏差 : 训练期间的采样分布 \\ pi 从内部口罩中取出口罩 I M\ mathcal{ I\ subset\ mathcal{M} (4 × 4 4\times 4 ),概率为 0.5 (等同), 强迫依赖外围提示 。

blocks.en: q q (keep rate) : The fraction of each training minibatch left unmasked. We set q = 0 q=0 , occluding every training image to maximize robustness to severe occlusions.
blocks.zh: q (保持率) : 每个训练小选手的分数都未露出面来. 我们设置了 q = 0 q = 0 , 覆盖每个训练图像, 以最大限度地坚固到严重隔离。

blocks.en: Normal training : Standard training on clean images with brightness scaling only; serves as the baseline model in original PatchCleanser.
blocks.zh: 普通培训: 仅用亮度缩放的清洁图像标准培训;作为原PatchCleanser中的基线模型.

blocks.en: PatchCleanser (original) : Baseline combining the unmodified PatchCleanser defense with a normally trained neural network.
blocks.zh: 补丁清除器(原作: 基线将未修改的PatchCleanser防御与通常训练有素的神经网络结合.

blocks.en: Ours : The combination of the exact PatchCleanser defense and certification procedure with a classifier trained via mask-aware training.
blocks.zh: 我们:精确的PatchCleanser防御和认证程序与通过口罩意识训练训练的分类器的结合.

blocks.en: Wide CNN : A five-layer convolutional neural network (0.73M parameters) trained from scratch on 32 × 32 32\times 32 inputs with ± 2 \pm 2 -pixel random translations and brightness augmentations for 40 epochs.
blocks.zh: 广通CNN:从零开始训练出一个五层分解神经网络(0.73M参数),32×32 32\times 32输入 ±2\pm 2 -像素随机翻译和亮度增强,可容纳40个纪元.

blocks.en: ResNet-50 : A 50-layer residual network (23.6M parameters) [ 12 ] initialized with ImageNet weights and fine-tuned on GTSRB at 128 × 128 128\times 128 for 30 epochs using mixed precision on GPU.
blocks.zh: ResNet-50:一个50层的残余网络(23.6M参数)[12]以ImageNet权重被初始化,并用128×128128\times128在GPU上使用混合精度为30个时代进行GTSRB上的微调.
